title: Computerized Axial Tomography (CT), Thorax
cms_cov_policy: <p>Title XVIII of the Social Security Act, &#167;1862(a)(1)(A) allows coverage and payment for only those services that are considered reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.<br /><br />Title XVIII of the Social Security Act, &#167;1862(a)(1)(D) items and services related to research and experimentation. <br /><br />Title XVIII of the Social Security Act, &#167;1862(a)(7) states Medicare will not cover any services or procedures associated with routine physical checkups.<br /><br />42 CFR &#167;410.32(b)(3)(i), (b)(3)(ii), (b)(3)(iii) Levels of supervision<br /><br />CMS Internet-Only Manual, Pub. 100-02, Medicare Benefit Policy Manual, Chapter 6, &#167;20.4.1 Diagnostic Services Defined, &#167;20.4.3 Coverage of Outpatient Diagnostic Services Furnished on or Before December 31, 2009, &#167;20.4.4 Coverage of Outpatient Diagnostic Services Furnished on or After January 1, 2010, and &#167;20.4.5 Outpatient Diagnostic Services Under Arrangements<br /><br />CMS Internet-Only Manual, Pub. 100-03, Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCD) Manual, Chapter 1, Part 4, &#167;220.1 Computed Tomography (CT)</p>
keywords: CT of Thorax|Computerized Axial Tomography, Thorax
associated_info: <p><strong><u>Documentation Requirements</u></strong><br /><br />Documentation must be legible, relevant and sufficient to justify the services billed. This documentation must be made available to the A/B MAC upon request. <br /><br /><strong><u>Utilization Guidelines</u></strong><br /><br />Reasonable and necessary imaging which is felt to be required more frequently than 6 times a calendar year, must have substantial documentation to describe medical necessity.</p>
